card.name: Words just before a disease name
card.fires_on: Linking or modifier words that come right before a condition name is spelled out, such as "Chronic" before Spontaneous Urticaria, or "for", "with" and "and" before a list of conditions. Also fires on the space before a number of weeks and on "Ph<<ysical>>" in a reference title.

modes.label: Chronic before a condition
modes.description: The word chronic opens a disease name in a dosing heading or indication list.
modes.example: 2.9 Recommended Dosage for<< Chronic>> Spontaneous Urticaria Dos

modes.label: Linking word before conditions
modes.description: A small word like and, with or for sits between conditions or patient groups, just before the next one is named.
modes.example: For patients with asthma, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP),<< and>> IgE-mediated food allergy, dosage determination

modes.label: Space before week interval
modes.description: The space after "every" or "or" just before a number of weeks in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: XOLAIR 75 mg to 600 mg SC every 2 or<< >>4 weeks. Determine dose (mg)

card.writes: It adds a bit of push toward diagnosis-related words such as Diagnosis and its translations.
card.plain: It notices the small word that comes just before a disease or condition is named.
